caption:
Your circle is poison. Not evil. Wrong. Your mindset reflects them. Your discipline is theirs. Start cutting.

Every top performer faced the same choice: keep people who drain you, or build with people who elevate you.

There's no middle ground. No staying friends with someone destroying your trajectory.

Your job isn't to fix them. Your job is to build with people who push you forward.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
